articles.title_en: The effects of labor market opportunities on education: The case of a female hiring ceiling in Iran
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场机会对教育的影响：伊朗女性招聘上限的案例
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effects of reduced labor market opportunities on women’s college education outcomes. To do so, we exploit discontinuity generated by a 2010 policy in Iran limiting female hiring in the public sector, which greatly worsened employment opportunities for college-educated women. We find that the reform immediately reduced women’s college attendance by 11.4% points while it slightly increased men’s college attendance. We also find that it decreased women’s enrollment in college majors wherein employment probabilities are more reduced after the reform. In contrast, we do not observe any significant impact on other outcomes, including high school education decisions, labor supply patterns of high school graduates, and spillover effects into the private sector labor market. Lastly, we note that those who do not attend college are more likely to get married and/or have children at younger ages. This paper shows labor market returns as an important determinant of education pursuit even in a country, where the society is highly conservative and women’s employment possibilities are low.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了劳动力市场机会减少对女性大学教育成果的影响。为此，我们利用了伊朗2010年一项限制公共部门女性招聘的政策所产生的断点，该政策极大地恶化了受过大学教育的女性的就业机会。我们发现，这项改革立即将女性大学入学率降低了11.4%个百分点，而男性大学入学率略有上升。我们还发现，它降低了女性在改革后就业概率下降更多的大学专业的入学率。相比之下，我们没有观察到对其他成果的任何显著影响，包括高中教育决策、高中毕业生的劳动力供给模式以及对私营部门劳动力市场的溢出效应。最后，我们注意到那些不上大学的人更有可能在较年轻的时候结婚和/或生育。本文表明，即使在一个社会高度保守且女性就业可能性较低的国家，劳动力市场回报也是决定教育追求的重要因素。

articles.title_en: Does going cashless make you tax-rich? Evidence from India’s demonetization experiment
articles.title_cn: 无现金化是否让你税收更丰富？来自印度废钞实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the tax compliance effects of India’s demonetization policy, which limited cash availability for a short period of time. Using administrative data on firms’ tax returns and variation in the strength of the demonetization shock across local areas, we find that demonetization increased sales reported to the tax authorities and tax payments. Investigating mechanisms, we show that demonetization led to a large increase in the use of electronic forms of payments. We argue that this likely strengthened tax authorities’ capacity to observe tax liabilities and enforce compliance.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了印度废钞政策的税收合规效应，该政策在短期内限制了现金供应。利用企业纳税申报的行政数据以及废钞冲击在不同地区的强度差异，我们发现废钞政策增加了向税务机关报告的销售额和税收支付。在机制探究中，我们表明废钞政策导致电子支付方式的使用大幅增加。我们认为这可能增强了税务机关观察税收负债和执行合规的能力。

articles.title_en: Voter attention and electoral accountability
articles.title_cn: 选民关注与选举问责
articles.abstract_en: What sorts of policy decisions do voters pay attention to, and why? And how does rational voter attention affect the behavior of politicians in office? We extend the Canes-Wrone et al. (2001) model of electoral accountability to allow the voter to choose when to pay costly attention to learn the consequences of the incumbent’s policy. We find that the voter will pay the most attention in close races, when the instrumental value of information about incumbent performance is greatest. When the voter’s cost of attention is ‘intermediate,” she will pay different levels of attention to different policies, and generally pay more attention to an unpopular policy than a popular one. This asymmetric attention can improve accountability by giving a moderately strong incumbent an opportunity to be “caught in the act of being good” after choosing an unpopular policy. However, it can also harm accountability by leading a moderately strong incumbent to categorically avoid the unpopular policy to evade voter scrutiny. This negative effect can be sufficiently strong to harm the voter’s overall welfare, providing a novel rationale for why subsidizing information about government performance may unintentionally harm voters. Finally, we find that rational voter attention can never induce “fake leadership,” i.e., a moderately weak incumbent choosing an unpopular policy precisely because it draws more scrutiny, hoping that the voter discovers an accidental policy success.
articles.abstract_cn: 选民关注哪些类型的政策决策，以及为什么？理性的选民关注如何影响在位政治家的行为？我们扩展了Canes-Wrone等人（2001）的选举问责模型，允许选民选择何时支付昂贵的关注来了解在位者政策的结果。我们发现，选民在竞争激烈的选举中会给予最多关注，此时关于在位者表现的信息的工具性价值最大。当选民的关注成本为“中等”时，她会对不同政策给予不同程度的关注，并且通常对不受欢迎的政策比受欢迎的政策给予更多关注。这种不对称关注可以通过给中等强势的在位者一个在选择了不受欢迎的政策后“因做好事而被抓住”的机会来提高问责性。然而，它也可能通过导致中等强势的在位者完全回避不受欢迎的政策以逃避选民审查而损害问责性。这种负面效应可能足够强大，以至于损害选民的总体福利，这为补贴政府表现信息可能无意中损害选民提供了一个新的理由。最后，我们发现理性的选民关注永远不会诱导“虚假领导”，即中等弱势的在位者恰恰因为不受欢迎的政策会吸引更多审查而选择它，希望选民发现偶然的政策成功。

articles.title_en: A quantitative analysis of subsidy competition in the U.S
articles.title_cn: 美国补贴竞争的定量分析
articles.abstract_en: We use a quantitative economic geography model to explore subsidy competition among U.S. states. We ask what motivates state governments to subsidize firm relocations and quantify how strong their incentives are. We also characterize fully non-cooperative and cooperative subsidy choices and assess how far away we are from these extremes. We find that states have strong incentives to subsidize firm relocations in order to gain at the expense of other states. We also find that observed subsidies are closer to cooperative than non-cooperative subsidies but the potential losses from an escalation of subsidy competition are large.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用定量经济地理模型来探讨美国各州之间的补贴竞争。我们探究是什么动机促使州政府补贴企业迁移，并量化其激励的强度。我们还刻画了完全非合作和合作补贴选择的特征，并评估我们距离这些极端情况有多远。我们发现，各州有强烈的动机补贴企业迁移，以便在其他州的损失中获益。我们还发现，观察到的补贴更接近合作补贴而非非合作补贴，但补贴竞争升级的潜在损失是巨大的。

articles.title_en: Incentives, globalization, and redistribution
articles.title_cn: 激励、全球化与再分配
articles.abstract_en: We offer a new explanation for why taxes have become less redistributive in many countries while the concentration of incomes has increased. Our argument is based on the prevalence of incentive contracts in modern economies, in conjunction with increased product market integration. Globalization widens the spread of project returns and makes contract choices more responsive to tax changes. This can result in a lower optimal income tax rate while simultaneously increasing the income share of top earners. These results are confirmed in a calibrated version of our model based on U.S. income data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为许多国家税收再分配功能减弱而收入集中度上升的现象提供了新的解释。我们的论点基于现代经济中激励合同的普遍性，以及产品市场一体化程度的提高。全球化扩大了项目回报的分布范围，并使合同选择对税收变化更加敏感。这可能导致最优所得税率降低，同时增加高收入者的收入份额。基于美国收入数据校准的模型版本证实了这些结果。

articles.title_en: Tax curvature
articles.title_cn: 税收曲率
articles.abstract_en: In a Mirrleesian environment, a monopsonist sets hourly wages and individuals choose how many hours to work. Labor market outcomes do not only depend on the level and slope of the income tax function, but also on its curvature. A more concave tax schedule raises the elasticity of labor supply, which boosts wages. Consequently, optimal marginal tax rates for low-skilled workers are declining in income. I derive an optimal tax formula in terms of sufficient statistics that accounts for the impact of tax curvature on labor market outcomes. Numerical simulations suggest that optimal marginal tax rates decline rapidly at low incomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在米尔利斯环境中，垄断买方设定小时工资，个体选择工作小时数。劳动力市场结果不仅取决于所得税函数的水平和斜率，还取决于其曲率。更凹的税收安排提高了劳动供给弹性，从而推高工资。因此，低技能工人的最优边际税率随收入递减。我推导了一个基于充分统计量的最优税收公式，该公式考虑了税收曲率对劳动力市场结果的影响。数值模拟表明，最优边际税率在低收入水平下迅速下降。

articles.title_en: Money versus Kudos: The impact of incentivizing local politicians in India
articles.title_cn: 金钱与荣誉：印度激励地方政治家的影响
articles.abstract_en: We present experimental evidence on the efficacy of a performance-based incentive in motivating elected politicians to improve delivery of a large-scale public program in India. The study randomly assigned presidents of village governments in the state of Tamil Nadu to one of two incentive schemes (or a control group): a financial incentive that rewarded better performing presidents with a higher public budget, and a nonfinancial incentive that awarded them a certificate demonstrating their achievement with an information campaign to disseminate it. The findings show that both incentives improved performance on multiple program dimensions, including expanding access to various safety net and public assistance schemes in the villages of incentivized presidents. The nonfinancial incentive also reduced between–hamlet differences in public resources allocated by presidents within their village, and it was significantly less costly to implement compared to the financial incentive. The results are also in line with standard voting models with imperfect information, where interventions that provide credible information on politician quality can help redress preferential targeting of resources that are prevalent in the status quo.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于绩效激励在激励当选政治家改善印度大规模公共项目交付方面有效性的实验证据。该研究随机将泰米尔纳德邦村级政府主席分配到两种激励方案（或对照组）之一：一种财政激励，奖励表现更好的主席更高的公共预算；另一种非财政激励，授予他们证书以展示其成就，并通过信息宣传活动进行传播。研究结果表明，两种激励都改善了多个项目维度的绩效，包括扩大激励主席所在村庄的各种安全网和公共援助计划的覆盖面。非财政激励还减少了主席在其村庄内分配给各小村公共资源的差异，并且与财政激励相比，实施成本显著更低。结果也与标准的不完全信息投票模型一致，在该模型中，提供政治家质量可信信息的干预措施有助于纠正现状中普遍存在的资源偏向性分配。

articles.title_en: Place-based consequences of person-based transfers: Evidence from recessions
articles.title_cn: 基于个人的转移支付的地方性后果：来自经济衰退的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how government transfers respond to changes in local economic activity that emerge during recessions. Local labor markets that experience greater employment losses during recessions face persistent relative decreases in per capita earnings. However, these areas also experience persistent increases in per capita transfers, which offset 16 percent of the earnings loss on average. The increase in transfers is driven by unemployment insurance in the short run, and medical, retirement, and disability transfers in the long run. Our results show that nominally place-neutral transfer programs redistribute considerable sums of money to places with depressed economic conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了政府转移支付如何应对经济衰退期间出现的当地经济活动变化。在经济衰退期间经历更大就业损失的当地劳动力市场，其人均收入面临持续的相对下降。然而，这些地区的人均转移支付也持续增加，平均抵消了16%的收入损失。转移支付的增加在短期内由失业保险驱动，长期则由医疗、退休和残疾转移支付驱动。我们的结果表明，名义上地方中性的转移支付项目将大量资金重新分配给经济状况低迷的地方。

articles.title_en: Minimum wages, retirement timing, and labor supply
articles.title_cn: 最低工资、退休时机与劳动力供给
articles.abstract_en: We find that minimum wage increases lead to increased employment for low-wage, retirement-age individuals using survey data linked to several decades of individual-level IRS and SSA data. Own-wage elasticity estimates of the employment effect are larger than normal for the minimum wage literature but are consistent with recent evidence on labor supply effects of minimum wages and life-cycle models of labor supply. We also find evidence of delayed permanent employment exit and delayed retirement benefit claiming. The delay in benefit claiming appears to be driven by an interaction between minimum wages and the Social Security earnings test. These results suggest that retirement-age individuals are very responsive to changes in labor market opportunities and that minimum wages may complement Social Security incentives that encourage more work and delayed benefit claiming.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用与数十年个人IRS和SSA数据相关联的调查数据发现，最低工资的提高导致低工资、退休年龄个体的就业增加。就业效应的自身工资弹性估计值高于最低工资文献中的常规水平，但与近期关于最低工资劳动力供给效应和劳动力供给生命周期模型的证据一致。我们还发现了延迟永久性就业退出和延迟退休福利申领的证据。福利申领的延迟似乎是由最低工资与社会保障收入测试之间的相互作用驱动的。这些结果表明，退休年龄个体对劳动力市场机会的变化非常敏感，最低工资可能补充社会保障激励措施，鼓励更多工作和延迟福利申领。

articles.title_en: Estimating students’ valuation for college experiences
articles.title_cn: 估算学生对大学体验的估值
articles.abstract_en: Quantifying the consumption value of college – the utility students derive from in-person instruction and on-campus social activities – has been challenging. We leverage the COVID-19 shock to elicit students’ intended likelihood of enrolling in higher education under different costs and possible states of the world, that vary in terms of class formats (i.e., in-person vs. remote instruction) and restrictions to campus social life. We show how such data can be used to recover students’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for college-related activities in the absence of COVID-19, without parametric assumptions on the underlying heterogeneity in WTP. We find that the average WTP for in-person instruction (relative to a remote format) represents around 6.5% of the average annual net cost of attending university, while the average WTP for on-campus social activities is 10.2% of the average annual net costs. Lower-income and first-generation derive substantially lower value from university social life, partly due to time and resource constraints. Beyond providing an explanation for why college persistence rates may differ by socioeconomic background, our results have implications for how college costs should be structured.
articles.abstract_cn: 量化大学的消费价值——学生从面对面教学和校园社交活动中获得的效用——一直具有挑战性。我们利用COVID-19冲击来引出学生在不同成本和可能世界状态下入读高等教育的意向可能性，这些状态在课堂形式（即面对面教学与远程教学）和校园社交生活限制方面有所不同。我们展示了如何利用这些数据来恢复学生在没有COVID-19的情况下对大学相关活动的支付意愿（WTP），而无需对WTP的潜在异质性进行参数假设。我们发现，面对面教学的平均支付意愿（相对于远程形式）约占上大学平均年度净成本的6.5%，而校园社交活动的平均支付意愿占平均年度净成本的10.2%。低收入和第一代大学生从大学社交生活中获得的效用显著较低，部分原因是时间和资源限制。除了为大学持续就读率可能因社会经济背景而异提供解释外，我们的结果还对大学成本应如何构建具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: The consequences of job search monitoring for the long-term unemployed: Disability instead of employment?
articles.title_cn: 求职监控对长期失业者的影响：残疾而非就业？
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of job search monitoring (JSM) on individual labor market outcomes of the long-term unemployed. Exploiting the implementation of a JSM program targeted at jobseekers under the age of 49, we set up a regression discontinuity design that credibly identifies the program’s causal effect on unemployment, employment, and disability insurance (DI) participation and participation in other social welfare programs within a three-year period. We find that JSM increases exits from unemployment to DI without affecting transitions into employment or other social welfare programs. We further find that the effect of JSM on DI materializes before any sanction can be imposed and monitored individuals are still 10 percentage points more likely to be on DI three years after the start of monitoring. Ultimately, exploring fiscal implications reveals that the decrease in unemployment transfers as a result of JSM is entirely offset by the increase in DI transfers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了求职监控（JSM）对长期失业者个人劳动力市场结果的影响。利用针对年龄在49岁以下的求职者实施的JSM项目，我们建立了一个断点回归设计，该设计可信地识别了该项目在三年期内对失业、就业、残疾保险（DI）参与以及其他社会福利项目参与的因果效应。我们发现，JSM增加了从失业到DI的退出，而不影响向就业或其他社会福利项目的转变。我们进一步发现，JSM对DI的影响在任何制裁实施之前就已显现，并且在监控开始三年后，被监控个体上DI的可能性仍高出10个百分点。最终，探索财政影响揭示，JSM导致的失业转移减少完全被DI转移的增加所抵消。

articles.title_en: Trade-offs between access and quality in healthcare: Evidence from retail clinics in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 医疗服务的可及性与质量之间的权衡：来自墨西哥零售诊所的证据
articles.abstract_en: In settings with inefficient public provision, expansions in low-cost private-market healthcare delivery may be welfare-improving by increasing access, but may be sacrificing on quality. I study the introduction of retail clinics at private pharmacies in Mexico. I find that entry led to large declines in public-sector emergency room visits and a small but significant reduction in public clinic visits for relatively mild respiratory infections. I also find a significant increase in public clinic visits for chronic conditions and a slight decline in emergency room visits, consistent with better disease management. However, I estimate a sizable association between retail clinics and a shift toward stronger antibiotics in private-market sales. Hence, although retail clinics improve access to healthcare, they may be overselling their patients.
articles.abstract_cn: 在公共供给效率低下的环境中，低成本私人市场医疗服务的扩张可能通过增加可及性来改善福利，但可能牺牲质量。我研究了墨西哥私人药房引入零售诊所的情况。我发现，零售诊所的进入导致公共部门急诊室就诊量大幅下降，以及相对轻微的呼吸道感染的公共诊所就诊量小幅但显著的减少。我还发现，慢性病的公共诊所就诊量显著增加，急诊室就诊量略有下降，这与更好的疾病管理相一致。然而，我估计零售诊所与私人市场销售中转向更强抗生素之间存在相当大的关联。因此，尽管零售诊所改善了医疗服务的可及性，但它们可能过度销售其患者。

articles.title_en: Does wealth reduce support for redistribution? Evidence from an Ethiopian housing lottery
articles.title_cn: 财富是否会减少对再分配的支持？来自埃塞俄比亚住房抽签的证据
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting the variation in wealth created by an Ethiopian housing lottery, we show that general attitudes towards redistribution and inequality aversion are not affected by a large positive wealth shock. New homeowners are, however, less supportive of taxing homeowners, highlighting a potential conflict between self-interest and preferences for redistribution. We also find evidence of endogenous beliefs: relative to losers, the wealthier winners are less likely to emphasize the role of luck in explaining economic success. We interpret this finding in terms of a self-serving bias.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用埃塞俄比亚住房抽签所产生的财富变化，我们表明，对再分配的一般态度和对不平等的厌恶并未受到大规模正向财富冲击的影响。然而，新房主对向房主征税的支持度较低，凸显了自身利益与再分配偏好之间的潜在冲突。我们还发现了内生信念的证据：相对于输家，更富有的赢家不太可能强调运气在解释经济成功中的作用。我们将这一发现解释为一种自利偏差。

articles.title_en: Tax competition in the presence of profit shifting
articles.title_cn: 存在利润转移时的税收竞争
articles.abstract_en: The popular view is that governments should crack down on tax avoidance by multinational corporations, but in practice, lax anti-profit-shifting policies are common. Here, we analyze how controlling profit shifting influences fiscal competition. Equilibrium tax rates are determined by the elasticities of two components: retained profit and capital mobility. Anti-profit-shifting policies decrease the elasticity of the first, but increase the elasticity of the second. The impact of these policies on equilibrium tax rates is then ambiguous. We show that there are cases in which laxer policies increase equilibrium tax rates and countries’ well-being by favoring investments. We use estimates of different elasticities to show that our model can support lax enforcement.
articles.abstract_cn: 普遍观点认为政府应严厉打击跨国公司的避税行为，但实践中，宽松的反利润转移政策却很常见。在此，我们分析控制利润转移如何影响财政竞争。均衡税率由两个组成部分的弹性决定：留存利润和资本流动性。反利润转移政策降低了前者的弹性，但增加了后者的弹性。这些政策对均衡税率的影响因此是不明确的。我们表明，在某些情况下，更宽松的政策通过促进投资来提高均衡税率和国家的福祉。我们利用不同弹性的估计值来表明我们的模型可以支持宽松执法。

articles.title_en: Economic spillovers and political payoffs in government competition for firms: Evidence from the Kansas City Border War
articles.title_cn: 政府竞争企业中的经济溢出与政治回报：来自堪萨斯城边境战争的证据
articles.abstract_en: When jurisdictions use business incentives to compete for firms, the political payoffs of winning firms are privately derived by the politicians of the winning jurisdictions, but the economic payoffs, such as new jobs, can spill over to the residents of non-winning jurisdictions. I study how potential political payoffs shape government competition for firms using a simple model of government competition and firm location choice. I use the model to propose an empirical approach of deriving lower bounds on political payoffs with data on accepted incentives. Applying this approach to the recent state competition between Kansas and Missouri for firm relocation within Kansas City, I find that the two states derived sizable political payoffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 当辖区使用商业激励措施竞争企业时，获胜企业的政治回报由获胜辖区的政治家私下获得，而经济回报，如新就业机会，可能溢出到非获胜辖区的居民。我使用一个简单的政府竞争和企业选址模型来研究潜在的政治回报如何塑造政府对企业竞争。我利用该模型提出一种实证方法，用已接受的激励数据推导政治回报的下界。将这种方法应用于最近堪萨斯州和密苏里州在堪萨斯城内争夺企业迁址的州际竞争，我发现这两个州获得了可观的政治回报。

articles.title_en: Estimating labor supply responses to Danish tax reforms
articles.title_cn: 估计丹麦税制改革的劳动供给反应
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the elasticity of labor supply at the intensive margin by applying the latest estimation strategies from the elasticity of taxable income literature to administrative register data on performed hours of work. Performed hours of work are contract hours plus paid overtime, minus paid absence, vacation, and holiday leave. I estimate elasticities of labor supply at the intensive margin (ELS), labor income (ELI), and taxable income (ETI) of 0.08, 0.06, and 0.1. The results show that the high ratio of ELI to ETI can be attributed to changes in labor supply for wage earners, capturing inherent labor responses. As a result, I explicitly connect the labor supply and ETI literatures. The labor supply response is driven by changes in contract hours, paid absence, and individuals switching between main and secondary employment. These results suggest that contextual factors such as labor market fluidity and flexibility are important to facilitate real responses to taxation and that labor supply responses are core underlying drivers of total responses to taxation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过将应税收入弹性文献中的最新估计策略应用于工作小时数的行政登记数据，估计了集约边际上的劳动供给弹性。工作小时数为合同小时数加上带薪加班，减去带薪缺勤、休假和假日。我估计的集约边际劳动供给弹性（ELS）、劳动收入弹性（ELI）和应税收入弹性（ETI）分别为0.08、0.06和0.1。结果表明，ELI与ETI的高比率可归因于工薪阶层劳动供给的变化，这捕捉了内在的劳动反应。因此，我明确地将劳动供给与ETI文献联系起来。劳动供给反应由合同小时数的变化、带薪缺勤以及个体在主要和次要就业之间的转换所驱动。这些结果表明，劳动力市场流动性和灵活性等情境因素对于促进对税收的真实反应至关重要，并且劳动供给反应是对税收总体反应的核心潜在驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Barriers to charitable giving
articles.title_cn: 慈善捐赠的障碍
articles.abstract_en: Donating to charity requires time, effort and attention. If the costs to give are perceived to be large, charities may lose out on donations. We develop a nonparametric test for the presence of these general nuisance costs and conduct a large-scale field experiment to show that costs to give are sizable and impactful. Potential donors were offered a 5:1 fixed match if their donation met or exceeded a minimum amount (e.g. $1, $5 or $10). Absent nuisance costs, the probability of donating should decrease as the minimum amount increases. We find the opposite. We estimate that about half of donors in our sample have nuisance costs of $7 or more. Eliminating these costs would double donations. Charities seeking to expand donations from small donors thus face challenges. Offering a fixed match for donations above a certain threshold may be more effective, by essentially covering nuisance costs, than the standard practice of subsidizing all donations with dollar-for-dollar matches.
articles.abstract_cn: 向慈善机构捐款需要时间、精力和注意力。如果捐赠成本被认为很高，慈善机构可能会失去捐款。我们开发了一种非参数检验来检验这些一般性麻烦成本的存在，并进行了一项大规模实地实验，表明捐赠成本是相当大的且具有影响力的。潜在捐赠者被提供5:1的固定配捐，前提是他们的捐款达到或超过最低金额（例如$1、$5或$10）。在没有麻烦成本的情况下，捐赠概率应随着最低金额的增加而降低。我们发现了相反的情况。我们估计，我们样本中约有一半的捐赠者的麻烦成本为$7或更多。消除这些成本将使捐款翻倍。因此，寻求扩大小额捐赠者捐款的慈善机构面临挑战。为超过一定门槛的捐款提供固定配捐，通过实质上覆盖麻烦成本，可能比标准的逐美元配捐补贴所有捐款的做法更有效。

articles.title_en: On the existence of private unemployment insurance with advance information on future job losses
articles.title_cn: 关于存在预先知晓未来失业信息的私人失业保险的研究
articles.abstract_en: We study the existence of a profitable unemployment insurance market in a dynamic economy with adverse selection rooted in workers’ advance information on future job losses. The new feature of the model is that the insurer and workers interact repeatedly. Repeated interactions make it possible to threaten workers with exclusion from future insurance benefits after a default on insurance premia. With exclusion, the insurer can offer not only insurance against unemployment risk itself but also against bad news about a future job loss. We discipline our model with estimates of the willingness to pay for unemployment insurance and the costs of adverse selection in the US. Our quantitative results illustrate that private unemployment insurance could be profitable for an exclusion length of one year. To stimulate the emergence of a private unemployment insurance market, policymakers can facilitate the creation of a registry that archives past defaults on insurance premia.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在一个动态经济中，基于工人对未来失业的预先信息而产生的逆向选择，是否存在一个有利可图的失业保险市场。该模型的新特点是保险公司与工人进行重复互动。重复互动使得在保险费违约后，可以威胁将工人排除在未来的保险福利之外。通过排除机制，保险公司不仅可以提供针对失业风险本身的保险，还可以提供针对未来失业坏消息的保险。我们用美国对失业保险支付意愿和逆向选择成本的估计来约束我们的模型。我们的定量结果表明，对于一年的排除期，私人失业保险可能是有利可图的。为了促进私人失业保险市场的出现，政策制定者可以促进建立记录过去保险费违约的登记册。

articles.title_en: Using schooling decisions to estimate the elasticity of marginal utility of consumption
articles.title_cn: 利用教育决策估计消费边际效用弹性
articles.abstract_en: This paper uses schooling decisions to estimate curvature in utility of consumption in developing countries. We show that the elasticity of marginal utility of consumption (EMUC) can be recovered from three sufficient statistics: (1) the price effect of schooling; (2) the income effect of schooling; and (3) the consumption cost of sending a child to school. We estimate the consumption cost of schooling using variation from the randomized roll-out of Progresa, a conditional cash transfer program in rural Mexico. Using estimates of income and price effects in the Progresa setting from Bergstrom and Dodds (2021), we estimate the EMUC at 1.6.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用教育决策来估计发展中国家消费效用函数的曲率。我们表明，消费边际效用弹性（EMUC）可以从三个充分统计量中恢复：（1）教育的价格效应；（2）教育的收入效应；（3）送孩子上学的消费成本。我们利用墨西哥农村有条件现金转移项目Progresa的随机推广变化来估计教育的消费成本。利用Bergstrom和Dodds（2021）在Progresa背景下对收入和价格效应的估计，我们估计EMUC为1.6。

articles.title_en: Helping struggling students and benefiting all: Peer effects in primary education
articles.title_cn: 帮助困难学生并惠及所有人：初等教育中的同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: We exploit the randomized evaluation of a remedial education intervention that improved the reading skills of low-performing third grade students in Colombia, to study whether providing educational support to low-achieving students affects the academic performance of their higher-achieving classmates. We find that the test scores of non-treated children in treatment schools increased by 0.108 of a standard deviation compared to similar children in control schools. We interpret the reduced-form effect on higher-achieving students as a spillover effect within treated schools. We then estimate a linear-in-means model of peer effects, finding that a one-standard-deviation increase in peers’ contemporaneous achievement increases individual test scores by 0.679 of a standard deviation. Our findings show that policies aimed at improving the bottom of the achievement distribution have the potential to generate social-multiplier effects that benefit all.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项补救性教育干预的随机评估，该干预提高了哥伦比亚三年级低表现学生的阅读技能，以研究向低成就学生提供教育支持是否会影响其高成就同学的学习成绩。我们发现，与对照学校中相似儿童相比，治疗学校中未接受干预的儿童的测试分数提高了0.108个标准差。我们将对高成就学生的简化形式效应解释为治疗学校内的溢出效应。然后，我们估计了一个线性均值同伴效应模型，发现同伴同期成就每增加一个标准差，个体测试分数增加0.679个标准差。我们的研究结果表明，旨在改善成就分布底端的政策有可能产生惠及所有人的社会乘数效应。

articles.title_en: Employer-sponsored health insurance premiums and income in U.S. tax data
articles.title_cn: 美国税收数据中的雇主赞助健康保险保费与收入
articles.abstract_en: The distribution of employer-sponsored health insurance premiums in the United States is difficult to fully characterize with survey data. Using administrative tax data, we plot the population distribution of premiums and provide new evidence about the relationship between premiums and demographic characteristics, including income. The distribution of premiums measured in the tax data is comparable to survey data. People with higher incomes are more likely to have an employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) policy and, conditional on having a policy, select more expensive plans. Because higher income policyholders and their employers spend more on ESI, they also receive a disproportionate amount of government subsidies for health insurance, even when we account for non-ESI subsidies through Medicare, Medicaid, and Premium Tax Credits. Even though the distribution of health subsidies is skewed toward those with higher incomes, it is less than a quarter as unequal as the distribution of income itself.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国雇主赞助健康保险保费的分布难以通过调查数据全面刻画。利用行政税收数据，我们绘制了保费的总体分布，并提供了关于保费与人口特征（包括收入）之间关系的新证据。税收数据中测得的保费分布与调查数据相当。收入较高的人更可能拥有雇主赞助保险（ESI）保单，并且在拥有保单的情况下，会选择更昂贵的计划。由于收入较高的保单持有人及其雇主在ESI上花费更多，他们也获得了不成比例的政府健康保险补贴，即使我们通过Medicare、Medicaid和保费税收抵免考虑了非ESI补贴。尽管健康补贴的分布偏向高收入人群，但其不平等程度不到收入本身分布的四分之一。
